args.sql:
SELECT 
    profiletrace AS profile_id,
    COUNT(*) AS failure_count,
    STRING_AGG(
        CASE 
            WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check'
            WHEN csumverify = 'Failed' THEN 'Checksum Verification'
        END, ', ' 
    ) AS failure_types
FROM 
    DataProfile
WHERE 
    intcheck = 'Failed' OR csumverify = 'Failed'
GROUP BY 
    profiletrace
ORDER BY 
    failure_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
